name: Suzlon Energy
about: Suzlon Energy Ltd. is a global leader in renewable energy, particularly in wind power solutions. The company designs, manufactures, and installs wind turbines, providing comprehensive solutions for wind energy projects. With operations in over 17 countries, Suzlon serves clients worldwide, offering end-to-end services including site identification, project development, and operations and maintenance. Its focus on sustainable energy solutions aims to reduce carbon emissions and promote clean energy development. Suzlon has played a pivotal role in advancing wind energy in India and globally, contributing to the transition towards a greener, more sustainable energy landscape through innovation and efficiency.
